decisions.decision: Mr. Luck was authorized to inform Wright Pierce in writing that the contract is accepted, without further motion.
decisions.quote: was authorized to inform wright pierce, in writing , that the contract is accepted without further motion.

decisions.decision: No bonus for completing the job early; all agreed no.
decisions.quote: discussion about a bonus for completing job early. all agreed no.

decisions.decision: Penalty and bonus clauses and liquidated damages would not be placed in the contract; all commissioners agreed to leave the terms in the not to exceed.
decisions.quote: all commissioners a greed it best to leave in the not to exceed.

decisions.decision: All agreed to a 'not to exceed' contract structure.
decisions.quote: all agreed to 'not to exceed' contract.

decisions.decision: Wright Pierce to prepare a not to exceed for the field inspection phase based on 860 hours; other changes to be handled by amendment.
decisions.quote: we will put together a not to exceed for field inspect ion phase based on 860 hours at rate, deal with otherwise by amendments.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Commissioners and Wright Pierce discussed the project budget size, its contingency (described as a cushion), and whether the contingency was adequate; the budget was described as having changed from $1.8M to $2.0M to $2.2M.
budget_items.quote: the $2.2 m was just in case, a cushion.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Wright Pierce said a typical contingency on a $2.2M job is 10-15%, and the DPW Director said a minimum of 10% is wise.
budget_items.quote: stated that overall it is wise to have a minimum of 10%.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Wright Pierce used a $200K lump sum as an example of how a fixed fee could be structured, which was said to be effectively the same as a not to exceed contract.
budget_items.quote: using $200k as an example, there could be a lump sum

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Commissioners calculated that Wright Pierce was comfortable with a rate of roughly $77 per hour, or $3200 per week.
budget_items.quote: calculated that wp was comfortable with the roughly $77 hr./$3200 week.

budget_items.topic: Police detail cost for the project
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Wright Pierce estimated $50K for police detail for the project, to be billed to the town because SRF funding does not allow police detail in the construction contract.
budget_items.quote: estimate $50k for police detail for project.

budget_items.topic: Police detail cost for design phase
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Wright Pierce guessed police detail for the design phase would run $2K.
budget_items.quote: guessed that police detail would run $2k for desig n phase.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The motion accepted the Wright Pierce proposal in the amount of $198,300.00.
budget_items.quote: in the amount of $198,300.00 to wright pierce.
